reviewer: Scout, advancement session 2026-10-27 (document and code review over the accepted unhcr-001 artifact, its gate 1.5.0 qualification report and the unhcr-baseline-001 runner-contract baseline; the figures cited are from the collected worker reports)
summary: Retained for retrospective model-development research under an isolated-rows protocol. Every feature reads only published years <= D and eligibility is decidable at the publication instant, but the HDX resource publishes one current distribution with no historical vintages, so training-label timing and full-row historical availability are unverified. A measured cross-row exposure exists by construction (a corridor's surged_recently in label year T+1 equals its label in label year T); the gate executed the declared probe on every split with zero mismatches, and the artifact is usable only under the restricted protocol the evaluation contract enforces.
supported_uses: Retrospective train/validation model-development experiments under the documented timing, vintage and selection limitations

Final evaluation only under a protocol that isolates the labeled holdout from agent development and prevents any later row (in particular the same corridor's next label year) from informing an earlier prediction
unsupported_uses: Claims of verified real-time, operational or point-in-time forecasting validity
Treating development/validation (eval-split) scores as untouched final-test results
Consuming rows without the isolated-rows restriction (the panel self-answers across adjacent label years of the same corridor)
Presenting the current-vintage panel values as the values an analyst at each past publication instant would have seen
Quoting the full-model eval AUC without the persistence references and their paired intervals beside it

cross_row_audit.scope: Gate 1.5.0 executed the declared probe next_label_year_exposes_outcome on the full artifact on the worker across all three splits: 2,439 train / 1,265 eval / 1,239 holdout rows covered, 0 mismatches - a label-year T+1 row's surged_recently equals the label-year T row's label. The exposure is a property of the panel's construction (one row per corridor per year, momentum features recomputed each year), is declared in quality.json's evaluation_contract, and is the reason access is fixed to isolated_rows. No broader attack search was run; the probe is the declared mechanism, not a proof of absence.

limitations: The HDX resource retains no historical vintages (update history observed 2025-11-05, 2026-02-25, 2026-06-11, 2026-06-19, 2026-06-22, 2026-08-20), so a reverse-history probe is not performable: this is retrospective research over the pinned 2026-08-20 distribution, never a certified historical forecasting setup.

Training-label timing is unverified: the 232-day publication lag is an observed release fact (the 2026-08-20 refresh carries complete data through year 2025), not a row-by-row availability ledger, and publications can slip.

Label-observability censoring excludes corridors whose host files no G/P report at all in the label year (33 rows counted, never labelled) and live-edge label-year-2026 corridors (496 counted); the observed panel is a censored sample of the eligible frame, reported not hidden.

Prevalence is not stationary across the panel (eval label years swing 1.4% to 18.8% positives; train 8.42% -> holdout 11.57%): pooled eval AUC blends regimes, and per-label-year figures are the honest grain.

The runner-contract stock baseline trails both persistence references on the identical eval rows (0.5393 vs 0.5742 momentum and 0.5856 surge flag; paired intervals contain zero, observed gaps negative): no headroom over persistence is demonstrated under this protocol, and the comparison is recorded beside every model figure.

required_actions: Keep the labeled holdout outside every evaluated agent's workspace; the benchmark's score is holdout AUC on a frozen design.
Enforce the isolated-rows access posture: no solver may read a corridor's later label-year row to inform an earlier one; the declared probe quantifies exactly this exposure.
Quote the full-model figure only beside both persistence references and their paired intervals; never quote any of the three numbers alone.
Re-run the gate's cross-row probe in every future re-qualification before making any stronger claim.
